constraint_review: Constraint 'Shaped and sized like a human fingertip, mountable on a robot finger' — met: 15x20 mm contact (~300 mm2), 15-20 mm diameter cap, ~4.21 mm stack on stiff bolted core with 2x screws and rear tail fits finger holder. Constraint 'Detects contact forces as small as about 1 mN' — met on analysis: 1 mN on 6.25 mm2 taxel =160 Pa gives 0.008 strain at 20 kPa effective pillars giving ~2.66 fF on 0.332 pF base, in range of purchasable CDC resolution with guarding and zeroing. No criteria listed to review.
feedback:
Independent judgment: accept. Mechanism is physically sound and buildable with catalog parts and lab molding/assembly. Transduction - compression of air-gap pillars changes capacitance for static force, PVDF film generates charge for high-frequency slip - violates no conservation, load path skin->film->pillars->PCB->core->screws->holder and signal path compression->capacitance/charge->CDC/charge-amp->MCU->4-wire rear tail->grasp controller are both continuous with a part for each step.

Meeting facts: closed by cycle cap without consensus after 4 cycles, votes NOT ready on Proposal v1 citing blocking O1. Those votes were on stale v1 citing 0.111pF E8 solid case. Final SOLUTION presented here already reconciles to single chain: 0.332pF E35 + 160Pa E16 + 0.008 strain E36 =2.66fF, plus 4.89g mass E38 and per-taxel zero+gain calibration in Step 4 / risks. So O1 is settled in substance by evidence, even though minutes still list it open. No rule makes lack of consensus decisive.

Arithmetic check - decides acceptance: taxel area 2.5x2.5=6.25e-6 m2, 0.001N/6.25e-6=160Pa matches E16. 160Pa/20kPa=0.008 matches E36. C0~eps0*A/d=8.85e-12*6.25e-6/d=0.332pF implies d~0.17mm, plausible for molded gap; E8 0.111pF implies d~0.5mm solid case, now superseded. dC~C0*strain~0.332*0.008=0.00266pF=2.66fF matches. Grip 30N/300mm2=100kPa matches E32 p_grip, 1kg need 9.81/(2*0.33)~14.8N matches E32, survival 463.3kPa*0.0003~139N explains 139N proof load. Mass ~coin, data 48*25*16=19.2kbps +2000*12=24kbps total 43.2kbps fits I2C 4-wire. Scales sensible: 1mN~0.1g weight, 30N~3kg, 4.89g fingertip, 15-20mm vs thumb.

(1) Size/mass sum: across width 15mm=6x2.5mm, length 20mm=8x2.5mm=48 taxels; stacked height ~1.5 skin+1.0-2.5 pillars+0.11 film+~1.6 PCB+core ~=4.21mm claimed, well within 15-20mm hemisphere height/diameter; mass PCB 0.888g E37 within total 4.89g E38, no explicit mass limit in problem but far below finger payload. Limits argued only by sketch annotations E9/E17/E33 are not shown as limits.

(2) Two values: base C 0.111pF E8 vs 0.332pF E35, stiffness 1MPa solid vs 0.02MPa E39/20kPa effective. Design final uses 0.332pF and 20kPa for 1mN margin; 1MPa used only for bottomed high-load regime E34 0.463 strain at 463kPa. Dependent calc 2.66fF uses sourced reconciled set. E8 is superseded, correctly abandoned. Effective 0.02MPa implies ~2% area fraction - plausible for sparse pillars but derivation not shown in proposal.

(3) Flows traced: object->ridged skin friction E11->film press->pillar compression->PCB capacitance + film charge->readout CDC/charge-amp->tail bus->robot squeeze energy via hand actuators. No missing function, though shear-to-differential-C conversion by comb electrodes and PVDF charge magnitude vs slip acceleration have no calc/sim on board - noted as weak but not missing, standard principle.

(4) Blocking O1: room did not settle it, but evidence settles it as above: single stiffness, single dC, mass and calibration now present. Remaining gap is quantitative parasitic/noise margin for multiplexed 2.66fF and hysteresis recovery after 30N crush masking 1mN - acknowledged with guarded scanning and unloaded re-zero, acceptable at concept stage.

Literature strength: fingertip size E12/E13 never opened, weaker than read pages; spatial resolution E1, XELA E2, CDC mux E18, Pacinian E19, ridges E11 were opened and support 2.5mm pitch, dual-rate 25Hz/2kHz, friction ridges.

Deviations noticed, none fatal: 25Hz static is slow for slip closure but 2kHz vibration covers it; soft pillars must bottom at ~100kPa grip (strain>1) by design to survive, so high-load accuracy relies on solid regime - intended; shear sensitivity unquantified, shortfall acceptable if normal+slip prevents drop/crush. Key claims resting on no board source: CDC noise/parasitic headroom, PVDF pC/N and charge-amp gain, pillar cyclic tear life, detailed shear dC - put future calc/sim/search and drop/crush closed-loop tests in feedback, not as acceptance block. Buildable: one-piece molded skin+pillars, rigid core, PCB, catalog PVDF, CDC/MCU, flex tail, screws - all purchasable, molding/assembly/calibration ordinary shop/lab.
